svg.title: Figure 7B: Stage 7 residual-stream activation patching across 6 local models
svg.desc: Recovery of counterfactual source-ID swap effect by patching donor activations into clean prompt runs across normalized model depth.
svg.text: Figure 7B — Residual-stream activation patching recovers identifier preference by late layers
Fraction of counterfactual swap effect recovered across normalized model depth; 1,710 activation patches across all 6 local models.
Teal: Citation context span (primary causal transfer, rises to ~1.0 in late layers)
Gray: Question control span (negative control, flat at 0.0)
Key finding: Patching citation-context activations cleanly transfers the counterfactual binding preference at late layers (recovery ~ 1.0).
Scope: Residual-stream activation patching only (1,710 total interventions across 6 models). See Figure 7A for prompt-level swaps.
